payload.text: **Build 0083 (vc), dc reviews -- FIRST after the compact, on hv's routing.** fullcycle's test phase becomes `test all` (shape A), with `in_all: false` as the override and no new key. The phase list stays defined once, in `_fullcycle_phases`; the STOPPING line and the build-passed line follow it, and the dry run lists it. Arms per the issue: a second declared test option runs after `build all` and the dry run lists it; an option marked `in_all: false` is skipped and reported as skipped; a project declaring only `rust` runs exactly what `test rust` runs today; a failing second option stops the cycle naming it. Check docs/configuration.md's sentence that `all` is synthesised "with more than one option", which 0083 says reads narrower than the behaviour. Red-first on today's lib/cmd/fullcycle, mutate every arm, tell dc before any full suite. lib/cmd/fullcycle is vendored, so the change joins the sweep pre-notice (todo 51).
